node.title: Rate-half MCA full-lift near-MDS extension reduction
node.closure: exact generalized-weight hierarchy and affine-list reduction for the full-lift branch
node.statement: In the full-lift top-explanation-rank branch, W=C+span(r_1) has dimension K+1, d_1(W)=e, and d_j(W)=N-K+j-1 for every j>=2. The selected errors form a full-affine-rank sparse list in one affine coset of W with unit slope fibers and information-set zero masks. The generic corrected compiler remains above both official budgets even at the MDS endpoint, so the residual requires additional RS-extension structure.
